lines: If you see a spare job site, do mention it kindly.
Give the job site I have not found yet room. Looking useful works better without elbows in it.
Step carefully near the job site I have not found yet. I would rather greet you than patch you up.
There you are. I was just near the village square, trying to keep the day sensible.
Morning. Or afternoon. The work makes the hours blur if I let it.
Good to see you walking in calmly. That usually means nothing is on fire yet.
If you need me, speak up. If you need gossip, speak quieter.
You caught me before the next little disaster. That is rare timing.
Hello. Try not to bring the whole village into this unless it is important.
I have a moment. Not a long one, but a real one.
Hello. If there is work, I am listening carefully.
You caught me between possibilities.
I was looking useful in case anyone noticed.
Good timing. I was almost busy by accident.
Come over. I have time, which is either a gift or a warning.
If you need help, start with the honest version.
Welcome. I am not tied to a station, so words travel easier.
I have two hands and no current excuse.
The square is full of tasks pretending not to see me.
Speak up. I was about to choose a direction at random.
Hello there. Did someone send you or did the day just get ideas?
I was checking which chores looked loneliest.
Stand wherever. My workplace has not been assigned yet.
Good to see you while I am between important errands.
You have my attention before someone borrows it.
